narrative.title: The Pipeline Sensor Repair Budget
narrative.scenario: A gas pipeline is monitored by sensors that report either 1 (healthy) or 0 (faulty), and the maintenance crew carries a budget of k replacement kits. Flipping a faulty sensor makes it healthy, and control wants the longest stretch of consecutive healthy readings achievable with at most k flips. The planner slides a frame over the sensor log, expelling older faults whenever the running fault count exceeds the budget.
narrative.inputFormat: A binary array nums of sensor readings and an integer k, the flip budget.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the length of the longest subarray containing at most k zeros.

testCases.explanation: Flipping two zeros welds the tail into six consecutive healthy readings.
One flip covers either fault, but both zeros can never sit inside the same frame.
